title: Bridge Builders, He Said

mood.label: Braced and waiting
mood.summary: Braced and waiting: pressure on Iran tightened as tankers hit mines near Hormuz, a gunman killed six in Krakow, Kyiv's power was hit and Gaza's tents flooded. Pope Leo urged Uruguay to build bridges, and COP31 opens tomorrow.

lines: They're closing roads to starve a war,
and six more names in lines.
The rain got into Gaza's tents,
Be bridge builders, an old man said
The talks in Antalya start tomorrow;
